∀ (height : ℕ) (cell : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId) (writes : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite) (acc : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Sources × Bool), ∀ entry ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.admitWrites height writes acc).1 cell, (∃ earlier ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup acc.1 cell, earlier.key = entry.key ∧ earlier.height = entry.height) ∨ entry.height = height ∧ ∃ write ∈ writes, write.cellId = cell ∧ entry.key ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.liveLinks write.canonicalPostBytes

∀ (height : ℕ) (cell : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId) (writes : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite) (acc : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Sources × Bool), List.map Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Entry.key (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.admitWrites height writes acc).1 cell) = match (List.filter (fun write => Decidable.decide (write.cellId = cell)) writes).getLast? with | Option.some write => Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.liveLinks write.canonicalPostBytes | Option.none => List.map Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Entry.key (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup acc.1 cell)

∀ (log : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord) (visible : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId → Bool) (keys : List Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey) {cell : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId} {key : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.LinkKey}, key ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.latestLinks cell log → visible cell = Bool.true → Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey.of key.2.target ∈ keys → ∃ entry, entry.key = key ∧ (cell, entry) ∈ (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.ofRecords log).backlinks visible keys

∀ (index : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Index) (visible : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId → Bool) (keys : List Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey) {pair : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId × Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Entry}, pair ∈ index.backlinks visible keys → visible pair.1 = Bool.true

∀ (log : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord) (visible : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId → Bool) (keys : List Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey) {pair : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId × Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Entry}, pair ∈ (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.ofRecords log).backlinks visible keys → visible pair.1 = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey.of pair.2.record.target ∈ keys ∧ pair.2.key ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.latestLinks pair.1 log ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.PresenceIndex.Occurs (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.WroteLink pair.1 pair.2.key) log pair.2.height

∀ (log : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord) (index : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Index) (record : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord), Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Exact log index → Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Exact (log ++ [record]) (index.admit (log.length + 1) record)

∀ (cell : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId) (log : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord) (record : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord), Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.latestLinks cell (log ++ [record]) = match Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lastWrite cell record with | Option.some write => Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.liveLinks write.canonicalPostBytes | Option.none => Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.latestLinks cell log

∀ (log : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord) (cell : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId), List.map Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Entry.key ((Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.ofRecords log).links cell) = Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.latestLinks cell log

∀ (reverse : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Reverse) (pair : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId × Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Entry) (key : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey), Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.addPair reverse pair) key = if Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey.of pair.2.record.target = key then pair :: Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup reverse key else Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup reverse key

∀ (height : ℕ) (acc : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Sources × Bool) (write : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite) (cell : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId), Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.admitWrite height acc write).1 cell = if write.cellId = cell then Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.refresh (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup acc.1 cell) height (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.liveLinks write.canonicalPostBytes) else Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup acc.1 cell

∀ {κ α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq κ] (map : List (κ × List α)) {key key' : κ}, key ≠ key' → Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup (List.filter (fun entry => Decidable.decide (entry.1 ≠ key)) map) key' = Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup map key'
∀ {κ α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq κ] (map : List (κ × List α)) (key : κ), Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup map key = [] ∨ (key, Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup map key) ∈ map
∀ {κ α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq κ] {map : List (κ × List α)}, (List.map Prod.fst map).Nodup → ∀ {pair : κ × List α}, pair ∈ map → Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup map pair.1 = pair.2

∀ {κ α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq κ] (map : List (κ × List α)) (key key' : κ) (value : List α), Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.store map key value) key' = if key = key' then value else Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup map key'

∀ (list : List (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId × Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Entry)) (key : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey) (pair : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId × Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Entry), pair ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup (List.foldr (fun pair reverse => Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.addPair reverse pair) [] list) key ↔ pair ∈ list ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey.of pair.2.record.target = key

∀ (sources : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Sources) (key : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey) (pair : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId × Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Entry), pair ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.lookup (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.invert sources) key ↔ pair ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.pairs sources ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey.of pair.2.record.target = key

∀ {sources : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Sources} {pair : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId × Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.Entry}, pair ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.pairs sources ↔ ∃ source ∈ sources, source.1 = pair.1 ∧ pair.2 ∈ source.2

∀ (log : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord) (document : Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.DocumentId) {key : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey}, key ∈ (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.ofRecords log).transclusionKeys document → ∃ cell, ∃ link ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.latestLinks cell log, Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.transcludedDocument link.2.target = Option.some document ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey.of link.2.target = key

∀ (log : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord) (visible : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId → Bool) (keys : List Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.TargetKey) {document : Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.DocumentId} {cell : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId} {key : Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.LinkKey}, key ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.latestLinks cell log → visible cell = Bool.true → Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.transcludedDocument key.2.target = Option.some document → ∃ entry, entry.key = key ∧ (cell, entry) ∈ (Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.ofRecords log).backlinks visible ((Minidregg.Kernel.LinkIndex.ofRecords log).transclusionKeys document ++ keys)
